title: Local AI Runtime Database — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Model formats, inference engines, hardware compatibility, and performance tests for running AI locally. The Local AI Runtime Database documents how to actually run AI models on your own machine: model file formats, inference engines, hardware backends (CPU, GPU, NPU), and measured performance. It is the companion to the Small Language Model Database — one picks the model, this one makes it run. Records include format converters, engine comparisons, backend setup guides, and troubleshooting for the failures everyone hits (out of memory, wrong backend, slow tokens).

title: Local AI Runtime Database — Knowledge: technical reference
body: Public edition. Sourced public knowledge, fact-checked reference; never mixed with Signature records. Format notes: GGUF stores quantized weights with metadata (architecture, quantization type per tensor); SafeTensors is a safe, mmap-friendly tensor store; ONNX is a graph interchange format for cross-engine execution. Engine architecture: loader -> tokenizer -> backend (CPU/GPU/NPU kernels) -> sampler. Key settings: context size n_ctx (KV cache grows with it), GPU layers n_gpu_layers (offload limit is VRAM), threads (usually physical cores). Sampler: temperature T scales logits (p_i ~ exp(z_i/T)); top-k/top-p truncate the tail. Failure modes: OOM at load (model bigger than RAM+VRAM), silent wrong output (quantization metadata mismatch), slow tokens (wrong backend selected).

Limitations: new engine versions change flags; Apple/Qualcomm/Intel NPUs differ in delegate support; measured tok/s varies by prompt shape. Recipes are re-verified per engine release.

demo.title: Verification: calibration error (ECE)
demo.code: const pairs=[[0.9,1],[0.9,1],[0.9,0],[0.6,1],[0.6,0],[0.6,0]];const bins={};pairs.forEach(([c,ok])=>{const b=Math.round(c*10)/10;(bins[b]=bins[b]||{n:0,c:0,conf:0});bins[b].n++;bins[b].c+=ok;bins[b].conf+=c;});let ece=0;for(const b in bins){const B=bins[b];ece+=Math.abs(B.c/B.n-B.conf/B.n)*(B.n/pairs.length);}J({ece:+ece.toFixed(3)});assert(ece>0&&ece<1,'ece');

demo.title: Execution: chunk and retrieve (RAG core)
demo.code: const doc='alpha beta gamma. delta epsilon zeta. eta theta iota. kappa lambda mu.';const words=doc.split(' ');const chunks=[];for(let i=0;i<words.length;i+=4)chunks.push(words.slice(i,i+6).join(' '));const q='zeta';const hits=chunks.filter(c=>c.includes(q));J({chunks:chunks.length,hits:hits.length});assert(chunks.length===3&&hits.length===2,'rag');
